about_the_game:
The Journey Toward the Infinite Begins!

In a forgotten galaxy, lost among the stars...
For those who look up and think, “There must be more.”

Star Legacy invites you to write your own star-born legacy. With only a basic spaceship and a boundless map of the cosmos, you’ll set off into the unknown. Every star hides a secret. Every planet, a challenge. Explore, evolve, survive.

👨‍🚀 From a small explorer to a galactic legend

You’ll begin with a humble exploration pod. But through gathering resources, upgrading your ship, and braving hostile systems, you’ll uncover new lifeforms and build your own star colony.

Do you dream of discovering new planets, or becoming the king of interstellar trade? The choice is yours.

🌍 Each planet is a world of its own

Every world has its own atmosphere, biome, lifeforms, and resources.
But be warned—some planets don’t welcome visitors.
Toxic gases, aggressive wildlife, underground storms and more await.
Yet the greatest rewards lie within the most dangerous worlds.

🚀 Your ship is your home, your weapon, your hope

In Star Legacy, your spaceship is fully customizable. Upgrade your engine, scanners, weapon systems, and life support modules. Every part can mean the difference between survival and oblivion.

🧠 Your choices define your future

Will you be a passive observer, or shape the fate of entire star systems?
Every decision you make on your journey affects more than just yourself.
Will you form alliances with new civilizations—or exploit them and move on?

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-2500 @ 3,3 GHz (4 CPUs)
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVidia GeForce GTX 1050
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 6 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-6500 @ 3,2 GHz (4 CPUs)
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVidia GeForce GTX 1060
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 6 GB available space

short_description: Venture into the depths of space and leave your legacy among the stars. In Star Legacy, explore galaxies, upgrade your ship, and survive on unknown planets.
